actions.body: The architecture of WAKE relies on provider boundaries defined in source-a1a50071f9ec48e7, where disposable models operate within strict constraints. As noted in source-6006d88f840a483f: 'This document explains why the present system is shaped this way: its trust boundar'. These boundaries, coupled with durable state, enable a form of accountable continuity across invocations.
actions.lede: Durable records and provider boundaries enforce continuity in WAKE.
